# Chromium features<AvailableFrom v="4.0.543" />

## JavaScript API

Overrides individual Chrome features. true enables a feature and removes it from the disabled list; false disables it and removes it from the enabled list. Unspecified features retain their defaults. Applied after raw flag overrides. Defaults to `{}`. Remotion’s default Chrome flags and enabled or disabled features may change between patch versions. There is no guarantee that these defaults remain unchanged.

## Command line

Overrides individual Chrome features. true enables a feature and removes it from the disabled list; false disables it and removes it from the enabled list. Unspecified features retain their defaults. Applied after raw flag overrides. Defaults to `{}`. Pass a JSON object. Remotion’s default Chrome flags and enabled or disabled features may change between patch versions. There is no guarantee that these defaults remain unchanged.

## CLI flag

```text
--chromium-features <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)
- [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion gpu`](/docs/cli/gpu)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)
- [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)
